answer: A forge forum weights moderation of ember safety warnings and umber glaze advice by account eligibility. Its server signs credentials only for accounts created 90 days before the poll, as an example cutoff. Validators check signatures and reject invalid credentials or repeated account IDs throughout the poll. Extra votes require buying eligible accounts or preparing aliases months ahead; reissuing credentials adds none. This trusts server records and slows sudden raids, but cheap parallel aging can defeat it.
